comments.author: @MadDawg345
comments.text: I just watched this video and alot of the clips you used is not even Cayman. If you going to do a video of my country at least use real footage of the island and not fillers of other places. People will watch this and get the wrong idea of how this country looks. I appreciate you doing a video of my beautiful island but do your due diligence on the clips you use.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: You're right, and thank you for saying it plainly as a Caymanian. Some of the B-roll in this one wasn't shot on the islands — that's a failing on our editing side, not a small thing, and we're flagging those clips for review. If you can point us to the timestamps that stand out most, it helps us fix it faster.

comments.author: @raymondryan896
comments.text: Cost of living is ridiculously expensive! But it’s home.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's the Cayman paradox in one line — one of the priciest places in the Caribbean to live, and still the only place that feels like home. Thanks for watching from the island.

comments.author: @Justgiveaclick
comments.text: Proud to say I’ve been living here for the past 16years. Won’t trade it for anything.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Thank you for your empathy and for taking the time to watch our documentary ❤️
